messages.text: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Vector Network Analyzer in Wireless Communication, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

### 推薦先賣
Ground equipment/user-terminal companies are tied to phased-array antennas, Ku/Ka-band, RF front-end, and system integration capability [3].
R&S ZNA67 covers 10 MHz to 67 GHz [74], and R&S ZNA67EXT covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz as a 1.0 mm VNA system [15].
R&S ZNA has mmWave converter support and direct IF access usable for mmWave converters and antenna measurement systems [65].
NR FR2 is defined as 24.25 GHz to 52.6 GHz, and FR2-2 is 52.6 GHz to 71 GHz [18].
5G FR2 conformance testing uses OTA/spatial metrics including EIRP, TRP, EIS, EVM, ACLR, spurious emissions, sensitivity, blocking, and beam-peak concepts [17].
Base-station conformance sources cover conducted and radiated transmitter, receiver, and performance testing under 3GPP TS 38.141-1 and TS 38.141-2 [20][90].
R&S ATS1800C is described as a conformance-grade CATR chamber with in-band 23.5 GHz–44.3 GHz and OOB extendable from 6/12 GHz to 90 GHz and beyond [91].
R&S ZNA67 covers to 67 GHz [74], while R&S ZNA67EXT covers to 110 GHz [15].
R&S ZNA direct IF access is stated for mmWave converter and antenna measurement systems [65].
The 2026 Taiwan wireless report links Wi-Fi 7 network-equipment ODM/OEM and LEO satellite supply chain as wireless-manufacturing growth themes [3].
The LEO supply-chain structure includes high-frequency PCB and RF components [37].
Wi-Fi 7 network-equipment ODM/OEM growth is tied to Wi-Fi 7 specification upgrades, 5G FWA, and broadband-speed upgrade replacement demand [49].
R&S PCB test solutions cover material measurement, stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring [30].
Those PCB workflows explicitly include impedance/TDR, Dk/Df extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, eye diagram, and process-monitoring contexts [28].
R&S ZNA options include Delta-L PCB characterization, deembedding, time-domain analysis, noise-figure measurement, mmWave converter support, and continuous data recording [67].
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S ZNA67EXT | mmWave / high-frequency RF and antenna work around LEO UT, phased-array, and FR2/FR2-2 ecosystems | 10 MHz to 110 GHz, 1.0 mm male test port, 2- or 4-port variants, 1 Hz resolution, 1 to 100001 points, 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz measurement bandwidth [15][80] | Knowledge base confirms the frequency coverage and VNA system specs; direct LEO/FR2 customer fit is not directly stated | LEO needs include phased-array, Ku/Ka-band, RF front-end, and test validation [3][37][38]; FR2/FR2-2 reaches 71 GHz [18]; ZNA67EXT reaches 110 GHz [15] | No price is provided [81]; source says ZNA67EXT is a product spec and does not provide market adoption [13] |
| R&S ZNA / R&S ZNA67 | mmWave converter, antenna measurement systems, RF front-end control, and 67 GHz VNA work | ZNA26/43/50/67 cover 10 MHz to 26.5/43.5/50/67 GHz [65][73]; ZNA67 has 10 MHz to 67 GHz, 2 or 4 ports, 1 Hz resolution, 1 to 100001 points, and measurement bandwidth up to 30 MHz with ZNA-K17 [74]; ZNA-B26 direct IF access supports mmWave converter and antenna measurement systems [65]; ZNA-B15 provides two independent MIPI RFFE busses and GPIO measurement/control functions [8] | Knowledge base confirms capabilities adjacent to antenna/mmWave/RFFE needs; direct wireless-market adoption is not stated | LEO UT evidence centers on phased-array antenna, Ku/Ka-band, RF front-end, and system integration [3]; 5G FR2 evidence centers on OTA/spatial RF metrics [17] | ZNA specs are product specifications and should not be merged with market/technology background as adoption proof [4] |
| R&S ZNL | Lower-frequency wireless-device, Wi-Fi-band, and entry VNA/spectrum-adjacent work | ZNL VNA frequency ranges are 5 kHz to 3/4.5/6/14/20 GHz depending model [36]; ZNL20 spectrum-analysis option reaches 26.5 GHz [36] | Knowledge base confirms frequency coverage suitable for lower-frequency RF work; direct Wi-Fi 7 VNA test role is not stated | Wi-Fi 7 uses 6 GHz band among its technical specifications [3]; ZNL6 reaches 6 GHz and ZNL20 reaches 20 GHz as VNA models [36] | ZNL source is a product spec and does not provide market adoption or customer cases [35] |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| LEO satellite user terminal / phased-array antenna / RF front-end validation | ZNA67EXT for up to 110 GHz, or ZNA67 with mmWave converter support and direct IF access; add ZNA-B15 where MIPI RFFE/GPIO control is needed [15][65][8] | Position around phased-array antenna, Ku/Ka-band, RF front-end, system integration, and test-validation needs already described in the LEO chain [3][37][38] | Formal customer cases, Starlink/Kuiper UT test flows, and accredited lab scopes are not proven in the vault [27][45] |
| 5G FR2 / FR2-2 mmWave R&D around antennas, fixtures, and components | ZNA67 for 10 MHz–67 GHz work, ZNA67EXT for 10 MHz–110 GHz work, and direct IF/mmWave converter support for antenna measurement-system contexts [74][15][65] | Use FR2/FR2-2 frequency expansion and OTA/spatial RF metrics as the demand discussion [18][17] | Conformance setups in the vault emphasize TS8980/CMX/chambers rather than VNA; VNA is not stated as the conformance tester [83][84] |
| High-frequency PCB/material/SI test for wireless ODM and satcom supply chains | ZNA family with time-domain, deembedding, Delta-L PCB characterization, and continuous recording options; ZNB3000/ZNL can be discussed where their frequency ranges fit [67][32][36] | Tie to material measurement, stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring [28][30] | PCB sources do not provide fixture, frequency, standard, sampling plan, control limits, or complete validation flow [28][29] |
| Wi-Fi 7 ODM/CPE engineering support | ZNL/ZNB/ZNA only as component, RF path, or PCB/SI adjuncts; CMX500 is the source-supported Wi-Fi 7 signaling tester [36][32][65][52] | Wi-Fi 7 ODM/OEM demand is supported by Wi-Fi 7 upgrades, 5G FWA, and broadband replacement demand [49] | The vault does not state that VNA is the primary Wi-Fi 7 R&D/production tester; Wi-Fi 7 test evidence points to CMX500 signaling mode [52][54] |

Product-spec sources for ZNA, ZNB3000, and ZNL do not establish market adoption, customer wins, pricing, or wireless-account fit [4][13][35].
Several wireless-market sources are market reports, presentations, or PR-style materials and have unresolved evidence gaps such as missing formal report metadata, accreditation scope, test standards, or detailed configuration matrices [24][27][61][88].
- 【推論】5G FR2/FR2-2 mmWave R&D is a strong VNA opportunity because FR2/FR2-2 frequency ranges and OTA RF metrics are documented, and ZNA67/ZNA67EXT cover 67 GHz/110 GHz measurement ranges [18][17][74][15].
- 【推論】High-frequency PCB/SI testing is a strong VNA-adjacent opportunity because wireless manufacturing demand includes Wi-Fi 7 and LEO high-frequency PCB/RF components, while R&S PCB workflows and ZNA PCB-characterization/deembedding options are documented [3][37][49][28][30][67].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 與既有知識的關係
- 本來源補齊 [[R&S ZNA]] 主系列，與既有 [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 形成關聯：[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer System，量測範圍 10 MHz to 110 GHz；本來源的 [[R&S ZNA67]] 是 67 GHz base VNA 型號，並可透過 [[mmWave converter support]] 與 accessories 延伸應用。
- 本來源與既有 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[R&S FSWX]] 等 spectrum / phase-noise analyzer 頁面在 [[Spectrum analyzer mode]]、[[Phase noise]]、[[Noise figure measurement]] 等功能上有橫向關聯，但本來源屬於 VNA 產品規格，不應與市場或技術背景合併。
- [[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS 與既有其他產品頁的 [[Health and utilization monitoring service]] 有橫向關聯；本來源列出 SNMP、REST JSON、SCPI、device web 等 readout/display protocols。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 讀圖補充
來源包含「【讀圖補充】原文這幾頁沒有文字層」；以下內容可信度低於正文，引用時應標示「[[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]]（讀圖）」。本次輸入的來源摘錄未提供圖片嵌入 wikilink，因此無法在 wiki 頁帶入原圖附件。

- p001（讀圖）：封面可辨識 R&S®ZNA、VECTOR NETWORK ANALYZER、Specifications、Version 24.00、ROHDE&SCHWARZ、Make ideas real、ZNA - Vector Network Analyzer、R&S；背景有類似 Smith chart 的大型圓形網格圖；設備螢幕顯示多個黑底網格曲線圖視窗；前面板可辨識 Port 1、Port 3、Port 2；可辨識數值只有 Version 24.00。
- p044（讀圖）：頁首 Version 24.00, April 2026；圖說為 Test set configuration for R&S®ZNAXx-B501 low power spurious reduction port 1。可辨識 Source、–20 dB、R&S®ZNAXx-B21 source step attenuator 0 dB to 70 dB / 10 dB、R&S®ZNAXx-B161 direct source monitor access、R&S®ZNAXx-B501 low-power spurious reduction 30 dB、R&S®ZNAXx-B31 receiver step attenuators 0 dB to 35 dB / 5 dB、Meas receiver、Ref receiver、Port 1、Source Out、Source In、Meas Out、Meas In、Ref Out、Ref In、Src Mon Out、10 dB。
- p050（讀圖）：頁首 Version 24.00, April 2026；圖說為 Side view of the R&S®ZNA；可辨識尺寸數值 452.1、407.6、131、272.43、272.43、116.1、161.95、56.3、110.5；尺寸數值旁單位無法辨識。
- p059（讀圖）：頁面幾乎空白，無實質內容；可辨識 Version 24.00, April 2026；Rohde & Schwarz R&S®ZNA Vector Network Analyzer；59。

R&S ZNA
[[R&S ZNA]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Network Analyzer 系列，依 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書涵蓋 [[R&S ZNA26]]、[[R&S ZNA43]]、[[R&S ZNA50]]、[[R&S ZNA67]]，頻率範圍從 10 MHz 延伸到最高 67 GHz。

R&S ZNA › R&S®ZNA-B15 RFFE GPIO interface 規格摘錄
- Models .02 and .03 提供 two independent MIPI RFFE busses。
- Connector type：25-pin D-Sub，female。
- RFFE port 1 / 2 的 VIO、DATA、CLK 電壓範圍為 0 V to +2 V，1 mV step，maximum current 20 mA。
- CLK configurable clock rate：31.25 kHz to 26 MHz。
- GPIO 1 to GPIO 8：voltage range –5 V to +10 V；typ. –6 V to +12 V；voltage step size 5 mV；maximum current 20 mA。
- GPIO 9 and 10：voltage range –5 V to +10 V；typ. –6 V to +12 V；voltage step size 5 mV；maximum current 100 mA。
- Model .03 提供 voltage and current measurement with switchable source resistance；32 internal ADC channels 可同時量測每個 RFFE 與 GPIO pin 的 voltage and current。

R&S ZNA › Measurement speed
- Measurement speed 測試條件：firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)。
- Acquisition time per point：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog wideband 時 1 µs；30 MHz measurement bandwidth 時 32 ns。
- Linear frequency sweep 條件 201 points、10 GHz center frequency、200 MHz span：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog normal 時 time per sweep < 3.9 ms；sweep cycle time < 4.9 ms。
- IEC/IEEE VXI11 over 1 Gbit/s LAN：201 measurement points、800 MHz start frequency、1 GHz stop frequency、1 MHz measurement bandwidth 的 measurement and data transfer time 為 14 ms / 13 ms；201 measurement points magnitude 的 data transfer time 為 1.7 ms / 0.9 ms。
- Switching time between channels with a maximum of 2001 points：< 2 ms。
- Continuous mode 不需要額外 data transfer time，因為 data transfer 與 measurement 同時進行。

R&S ZNA67 › Software options
[[R&S ZNA67]] 可使用 [[R&S ZNA]] 系列 software / measurement options。需注意 [[R&S ZNA-K1]] spectrum analyzer mode 不能與 R&S®ZNA67-B312、R&S®ZNA67-B511 組合；此限制為來源原文列出的 excludes / cannot be combined 關係。

[[R&S ZNA67]] 與既有 [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 相關但不是同一頁：[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer System，依既有 index 記錄量測範圍 10 MHz to 110 GHz；本頁為 67 GHz base VNA 型號。

R&S ZNA67
[[R&S ZNA67]] 是 [[R&S ZNA]] 系列的 67 GHz Vector Network Analyzer 型號，依 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書提供 2-port 與 4-port base unit。

R&S ZNA67 › 文件依據
- 來源：[[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]]。
- 文件：R&S®ZNA Vector Network Analyzer Specifications。
- 文件編號：PD 5215.4652.22。
- 文件版本：Version 24.00。
- 發布時間：April 2026。

ZNA67EXT_specs_en_5216-3743-22_v0900 › 與既有知識的關係
- [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是以 [[R&S ZNA67]] 為 base vector network analyzer 的 110 GHz 1.0 mm system；[[R&S ZNA67]] 本體完整規格見 [[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]]。
- [[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]] 是 R&S ZNA 系列 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書，晚於本來源；但兩者層級不同，前者描述 base VNA，本文描述 ZNA67EXT system，因此目前未判定為矛盾。
- 本來源屬於 [[Productions]] 長期產品規格資料；不寫市場採用情況，也不補充 [[Vector Network Analyzer]] 技術原理。

ZNA67EXT_specs_en_5216-3743-22_v0900 › p001
![[ZNA67EXT_specs_en_5216-3743-22_v0900-p001.png]]

可辨識封面文字包含：R&S®ZNA67EXT、VECTOR NETWORK ANALYZER SYSTEM、Specifications、Specifications Version 09.00、ROHDE&SCHWARZ、Make ideas real，以及 logo 內的 R / S。讀圖描述指出頁面中央偏下有一張系統照片，包含一台主機設備、前方兩個外接模組/機箱與多條纜線；主機螢幕上的細小文字無法辨識。

ZNA67EXT_specs_en_5216-3743-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] Vector Network Analyzer System 的 specifications，文件標示為 **PD 5216.3743.22 | Version 09.00 | July 2025 (ja)**，頁首也標示 **Version 09.00, July 2025**。

[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm [[Vector Network Analyzer]] system，涵蓋 **10 MHz to 110 GHz**。系統由一台 [[R&S ZNA67]] vector network analyzer 與最多四個 external test sets 組成；來源說明規格只對照 R&S ZNA67 rear panel designation scheme 中 type、serial numbers 與正確 port 位置完全一致的 system configuration 有效。

主要產品資訊：

- Impedance：**50 Ω**。
- Test port connector：**1.0 mm, male**。
- Number of test ports：models **.12/.13/.15/.16** 為 **2**；models **.14/.17** 為 **4**。
- Frequency range：**10 MHz to 110 GHz**。
- Frequency resolution：**1 Hz**。
- Number of measurement points：user-selectable **1 to 100001**。
- Measurement bandwidths：**1 Hz to 1.5 MHz**，1/1.5/2/3/5/7 steps。
- Calibration interval：**1 year**。

來源列出 6 個 base unit order no.，包含 standard power 與 high power、2 test ports 與 4 test ports variants；也列出 [[R&S ZNA67]] base unit options、software licenses / firmware options、cable sets、calibration kit、power sensor 與 test cable。

本次 ingest 也補入來源中的資料定義、uncorrected system data、trace stability、temperature dependence，以及讀圖封面資訊。讀圖資訊來自來源的「【讀圖補充】」段落，可信度低於正文。

5G FR2 RF conformance testing
[[5G FR2 RF conformance testing]] 是針對 5G NR UE 在 [[NR FR2]] / mmWave 頻段的 RF / RRM conformance 測試主題；[[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]]（檔名日期 2020-11-02）以 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]] / [[R&S TS8980FTA]] series customer presentation 形式整理 3GPP 規格、FR2 bands、OTA spatial metrics、chamber portfolio、system configurations 與 2021 roadmap。

5G FR2 RF conformance testing › OTA / spatial test metrics
本來源以 [[FR2 OTA spatial test metrics]] 方式整理 FR2 conformance 的 power / sensitivity / beam peak 量測語彙。

依 Slide 10：

- Scan / Max Power：[[EIRP]] CDF。
- 6.2.1 Max Tx Power：[[TRP]] / [[EIRP]] @ TX-BP。
- 6.3.1 Min Tx Power：[[EIRP]] @ TX-BP。
- 6.3.2 Off Power：[[TRP]] @ TX-BP。
- 6.4.2.2 EVM：@ TX-BP。
- 6.5.2 SEM：[[TRP]] @ BP。
- 6.5.3.2.4 ACLR：[[TRP]] / [[EIRP]] @ BP。
- TX Spurious Emissions：[[TRP]] @ BP。
- Scan / Throughput Scan：[[EIS]] CDF。
- 7.3 Reference Sensitivity, EIS：@ RX-BP。
- 7.4 Max Input Level：@ RX-BP。
- 7.5 ACS：@ RX-BP。
- 7.6.1 In-Band Blocking：@ RX-BP。
- 7.9 Rx Spurious Emissions：[[TRP]] @ RX-BP。

Slide note：

- Chapter 6 的 beam peak 是 Tx beam peak，即 100%-tile of EIRP CDF = strongest beam。
- Chapter 7 的 beam peak 是 Rx beam peak，即 0%-tile of EIS CDF = strongest beam；來源註明 0%-tile is where the most sensitive link was found。

5G FR2 RF conformance testing › Frequency range baseline
[[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] 補入 FR1 / FR2 的基本 range 定義：

| Frequency range | Range | Release 標示 | 來源 |
|---|---:|---|---|
| [[NR FR1]] | 410 MHz to 7125 MHz | Release 15 | [[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] |
| [[NR FR2]] / [[FR2-1]] | 24.25 GHz to 52.6 GHz | Release 15 | [[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] |
| [[FR2-2]] | 52.6 GHz to 71 GHz | Release 17 | [[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] |

判斷：這補充本頁的 FR2 測試背景，但不改寫 2020 presentation 的 band table 與 roadmap 內容；[[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] 未提供 conformance test procedure、limits 或 GCF/PTCRB validation status。

- Product data 適用條件：於環境溫度下存放 3 小時後，進行 30 分鐘 warm-up operation；符合 specified environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。
- 文件定義：Specifications with limits 與 specifications without limits 代表保證性能；non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證；uncertainties 以 coverage factor 2 並依 GUM 計算。
- 共通 VNA 量測：impedance 50 Ω；number of test ports 2；frequency resolution 1 Hz；number of measurement points per trace 1 to 100001；measurement bandwidth 1 Hz to 500 kHz，1/1.5/2/3/5/7 sequence。
- VNA frequency range：[[R&S ZNL3]] 為 5 kHz to 3 GHz；[[R&S ZNL4]] 為 5 kHz to 4.5 GHz；[[R&S ZNL6]] 為 5 kHz to 6 GHz；[[R&S ZNL14]] 為 5 kHz to 14 GHz；[[R&S ZNL20]] 為 5 kHz to 20 GHz。
- Test port connector：[[R&S ZNL3]]、[[R&S ZNL4]]、[[R&S ZNL6]]、[[R&S ZNL14]] 為 N, female；[[R&S ZNL20]] 為 3.5 mm, male。
- Dynamic range 規格條件：0 dBm source power 與 transmission magnitude data trace RMS value 的差；test ports short-circuited；10 Hz measurement bandwidth；without system error correction。使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range。
- Measurement accuracy 有效條件：+18 °C to +28 °C；calibration 後溫度變化不超過 1 °C；依 port connector 使用 [[R&S ZV-Z270]] 或 [[R&S ZN-Z235]] calibration kit；TOSM/SOLT；measurement 與 calibration 的 frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 相同；不允許 interpolation。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

Wi-Fi 8 › CES 2026 外部待讀連結
[[WiFi8]]（raw converted 2026-09-17）是 OneNote link hub，列出與 [[CES 2026]]、[[Broadcom]]、[[ASUS]]、[[MediaTek]]、[[Filogic 8000]] 與 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 相關的外部文章連結。該來源只提供連結標題與 URL，未擷取正文，因此目前只能支撐 [[Wi-Fi 8 外部資料清單]]，不能作為標準內容、晶片規格、路由器展示或量產時程的證據。

可追溯的連結線索包括：

- Tom's Hardware 標題提到 [[Broadcom]] two dual-band [[Wi-Fi 8]] chips。
- TechNews / The Verge 標題提到 [[Wi-Fi 8]] router / CES before most users have switched to [[Wi-Fi 7]]。
- RCR Wireless 標題提到 [[MediaTek]] previews [[Filogic 8000]] at [[CES 2026]]。
- EDN 標題提到 [[Wi-Fi 8]] silicon 與 AI touch。
- Network World 標題提到 [[Wi-Fi 8]] prioritizes reliability over speed gains。

以上均為待讀線索，不新增本頁的技術規格主張。

Wi-Fi 8 › 480 MHz waveform candidate 說法
[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 稱：

- [[R&S CMP180]] supports bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] will demonstrate its ability to verify a [[WLAN]] waveform with **480 MHz bandwidth** in loopback mode。
- 該 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] standard。

此說法目前只能作為 MWC 2024 PR 的 candidate / discussion 記錄；不得推論 480 MHz 已成為 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 標準通道頻寬。

Wi-Fi 8
[[Wi-Fi 8]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 中對 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment 的市場 / 技術稱呼；該來源描述其重點從提高 throughput 轉向 ultra-high reliability（[[UHR]]）connectivity performance。較早的 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則把 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 稱為 yet-to-be-defined，並提到 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion 與 480 MHz WLAN waveform potential candidate。

⚠️ [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]（MWC 2024；發布日期來源未標示）說 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 尚未定義，且 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion，並稱 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform 是 potential waveform candidate，但既有頁面 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 說依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] Wi‑Fi 8 保留 up to 320 MHz channel bandwidth。判斷：前者是較早期 discussion / candidate，後者是較晚 PR 的 implemented signaling-test description；先並列，不把 480 MHz 寫成 Wi‑Fi 8 正式規格。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › 與 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試的區分
本頁不同於 [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 目前由 Bluetest / EMITE OTA chamber PR 支撐，聚焦 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] over-the-air chamber workflow。
- [[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 目前由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] / [[Broadcom]] PR 支撐，聚焦 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling mode、[[Wi-Fi 8]] PHY features 與 prototype Broadcom WLAN device。
- 本來源未說明 OTA chamber、reverberation chamber、anechoic chamber、antenna performance 或 MIMO stress testing setup。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration statement，不是 datasheet、configuration guide、IEEE standard text 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 8 option code、license、software version、hardware configuration、RF chain count、test case list 或 measurement uncertainty。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[Broadcom]] prototype device 的正式產品名稱、量產狀態、客戶、driver version、chipset SKU 或商用 availability。
- 來源未標示 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] draft version、final ratification date 或正式標準版本。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › Wi-Fi 8 測試重點
來源描述 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] / [[Wi-Fi 8]] 的重點從 sheer speed 轉向 [[UHR]] performance。相關測試重點包括：

| 測試 / feature | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| [[distributed resource units]] / dRU measurements | 用於驗證 device boosting uplink transmit power 與 improving connection reliability 的 effectiveness；來源提到 dRU 可 overcome PSD limits。 |

### 推薦先賣
Ground equipment/user-terminal companies are tied to phased-array antennas, Ku/Ka-band, RF front-end, and system integration capability [3].
R&S ZNA67 covers 10 MHz to 67 GHz [74], and R&S ZNA67EXT covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz as a 1.0 mm VNA system [15].
R&S ZNA has mmWave converter support and direct IF access usable for mmWave converters and antenna measurement systems [65].
NR FR2 is defined as 24.25 GHz to 52.6 GHz, and FR2-2 is 52.6 GHz to 71 GHz [18].
5G FR2 conformance testing uses OTA/spatial metrics including EIRP, TRP, EIS, EVM, ACLR, spurious emissions, sensitivity, blocking, and beam-peak concepts [17].
Base-station conformance sources cover conducted and radiated transmitter, receiver, and performance testing under 3GPP TS 38.141-1 and TS 38.141-2 [20][90].
R&S ATS1800C is described as a conformance-grade CATR chamber with in-band 23.5 GHz–44.3 GHz and OOB extendable from 6/12 GHz to 90 GHz and beyond [91].
R&S ZNA67 covers to 67 GHz [74], while R&S ZNA67EXT covers to 110 GHz [15].
R&S ZNA direct IF access is stated for mmWave converter and antenna measurement systems [65].
The 2026 Taiwan wireless report links Wi-Fi 7 network-equipment ODM/OEM and LEO satellite supply chain as wireless-manufacturing growth themes [3].
The LEO supply-chain structure includes high-frequency PCB and RF components [37].
Wi-Fi 7 network-equipment ODM/OEM growth is tied to Wi-Fi 7 specification upgrades, 5G FWA, and broadband-speed upgrade replacement demand [49].
R&S PCB test solutions cover material measurement, stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring [30].
Those PCB workflows explicitly include impedance/TDR, Dk/Df extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, eye diagram, and process-monitoring contexts [28].
R&S ZNA options include Delta-L PCB characterization, deembedding, time-domain analysis, noise-figure measurement, mmWave converter support, and continuous data recording [67].
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S ZNA67EXT | mmWave / high-frequency RF and antenna work around LEO UT, phased-array, and FR2/FR2-2 ecosystems | 10 MHz to 110 GHz, 1.0 mm male test port, 2- or 4-port variants, 1 Hz resolution, 1 to 100001 points, 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz measurement bandwidth [15][80] | Knowledge base confirms the frequency coverage and VNA system specs; direct LEO/FR2 customer fit is not directly stated | LEO needs include phased-array, Ku/Ka-band, RF front-end, and test validation [3][37][38]; FR2/FR2-2 reaches 71 GHz [18]; ZNA67EXT reaches 110 GHz [15] | No price is provided [81]; source says ZNA67EXT is a product spec and does not provide market adoption [13] |
| R&S ZNA / R&S ZNA67 | mmWave converter, antenna measurement systems, RF front-end control, and 67 GHz VNA work | ZNA26/43/50/67 cover 10 MHz to 26.5/43.5/50/67 GHz [65][73]; ZNA67 has 10 MHz to 67 GHz, 2 or 4 ports, 1 Hz resolution, 1 to 100001 points, and measurement bandwidth up to 30 MHz with ZNA-K17 [74]; ZNA-B26 direct IF access supports mmWave converter and antenna measurement systems [65]; ZNA-B15 provides two independent MIPI RFFE busses and GPIO measurement/control functions [8] | Knowledge base confirms capabilities adjacent to antenna/mmWave/RFFE needs; direct wireless-market adoption is not stated | LEO UT evidence centers on phased-array antenna, Ku/Ka-band, RF front-end, and system integration [3]; 5G FR2 evidence centers on OTA/spatial RF metrics [17] | ZNA specs are product specifications and should not be merged with market/technology background as adoption proof [4] |
| R&S ZNL | Lower-frequency wireless-device, Wi-Fi-band, and entry VNA/spectrum-adjacent work | ZNL VNA frequency ranges are 5 kHz to 3/4.5/6/14/20 GHz depending model [36]; ZNL20 spectrum-analysis option reaches 26.5 GHz [36] | Knowledge base confirms frequency coverage suitable for lower-frequency RF work; direct Wi-Fi 7 VNA test role is not stated | Wi-Fi 7 uses 6 GHz band among its technical specifications [3]; ZNL6 reaches 6 GHz and ZNL20 reaches 20 GHz as VNA models [36] | ZNL source is a product spec and does not provide market adoption or customer cases [35] |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| LEO satellite user terminal / phased-array antenna / RF front-end validation | ZNA67EXT for up to 110 GHz, or ZNA67 with mmWave converter support and direct IF access; add ZNA-B15 where MIPI RFFE/GPIO control is needed [15][65][8] | Position around phased-array antenna, Ku/Ka-band, RF front-end, system integration, and test-validation needs already described in the LEO chain [3][37][38] | Formal customer cases, Starlink/Kuiper UT test flows, and accredited lab scopes are not proven in the vault [27][45] |
| 5G FR2 / FR2-2 mmWave R&D around antennas, fixtures, and components | ZNA67 for 10 MHz–67 GHz work, ZNA67EXT for 10 MHz–110 GHz work, and direct IF/mmWave converter support for antenna measurement-system contexts [74][15][65] | Use FR2/FR2-2 frequency expansion and OTA/spatial RF metrics as the demand discussion [18][17] | Conformance setups in the vault emphasize TS8980/CMX/chambers rather than VNA; VNA is not stated as the conformance tester [83][84] |
| High-frequency PCB/material/SI test for wireless ODM and satcom supply chains | ZNA family with time-domain, deembedding, Delta-L PCB characterization, and continuous recording options; ZNB3000/ZNL can be discussed where their frequency ranges fit [67][32][36] | Tie to material measurement, stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring [28][30] | PCB sources do not provide fixture, frequency, standard, sampling plan, control limits, or complete validation flow [28][29] |
| Wi-Fi 7 ODM/CPE engineering support | ZNL/ZNB/ZNA only as component, RF path, or PCB/SI adjuncts; CMX500 is the source-supported Wi-Fi 7 signaling tester [36][32][65][52] | Wi-Fi 7 ODM/OEM demand is supported by Wi-Fi 7 upgrades, 5G FWA, and broadband replacement demand [49] | The vault does not state that VNA is the primary Wi-Fi 7 R&D/production tester; Wi-Fi 7 test evidence points to CMX500 signaling mode [52][54] |
### 限制
Product-spec sources for ZNA, ZNB3000, and ZNL do not establish market adoption, customer wins, pricing, or wireless-account fit [4][13][35].
Several wireless-market sources are market reports, presentations, or PR-style materials and have unresolved evidence gaps such as missing formal report metadata, accreditation scope, test standards, or detailed configuration matrices [24][27][61][88].
- 【推論】5G FR2/FR2-2 mmWave R&D is a strong VNA opportunity because FR2/FR2-2 frequency ranges and OTA RF metrics are documented, and ZNA67/ZNA67EXT cover 67 GHz/110 GHz measurement ranges [18][17][74][15].
- 【推論】High-frequency PCB/SI testing is a strong VNA-adjacent opportunity because wireless manufacturing demand includes Wi-Fi 7 and LEO high-frequency PCB/RF components, while R&S PCB workflows and ZNA PCB-characterization/deembedding options are documented [3][37][49][28][30][67].
